title: ProjectE measurement-versus-simulation correlation report
description: Output of tools/scripts/sim/correlate.py. This is the first report in the bundle whose numbers could show a MODEL is wrong: everything upstream is self-consistent, and field_solver's bounded grid error says the numerics converged, not that the answer matches copper. Two fields carry the honesty load: 'de_embedded', which the caller declares and the tool never infers, and MEASUREMENT_ABSENT, which is the expected state until a board exists and means the model is unfalsified rather than confirmed.

signoff.description: A small residual says the model and the measurement AGREE, not that either is right: a launch de-embedded to the wrong reference plane can move both.

status.description: NO_COVERAGE covers both 'no measurement exists yet' and 'the two sweeps barely overlap'. Neither is a failure and neither is a pass.

de_embedded.description: DECLARED by the caller, never inferred. An un-de-embedded launch moves both magnitude and delay, and no amount of staring at a residual separates that from a wrong er - so when this is false the report emits FIXTURE_NOT_DE_EMBEDDED and the residual must be read as containing the fixture.

overlap.description: Only frequencies present in BOTH sweeps are compared. Interpolating one onto the other is not offered: resampling a measurement invents points that were never taken, and they then appear in the residual as if they had been.

mean.description: SIGNED, and reported separately from mean_absolute because the sign is the finding: a model uniformly 0.4 dB optimistic reads very differently from one 0.4 dB out in random directions.

verdict.description: The ACCEPTANCE axis, separate from the top-level status. PASS/FAIL only when a criterion was actually applied to a trustworthy value; NO_COVERAGE when none was supplied. The top-level status answers 'did the computation complete', which is why an ungated run can be GREEN there and NO_COVERAGE here. A threshold nobody stated cannot have been met.

verdict_reason.description: Why the acceptance verdict is NO_COVERAGE. Present exactly when no criterion was applied or the value was not trustworthy.

model_feedback.description: The er_eff that would have reproduced the measured delay, since delay scales as sqrt(er_eff). A POINTER for investigation, not a correction to apply: the same delay error can equally be a wrong length or an un-de-embedded fixture, and this cannot tell them apart. Nothing applies it automatically.
